integrity: Facets and fractional-matching vertex characterizations are credited to published sources. The analytic proof is self-contained given the standard facet inequality description. Finite checks are explicitly not a proof for all n.
scientific_limitations: Exact intrinsic Euclidean claim for complete unweighted graphs of order at least four only; absolute historical novelty is not certified; matching-polytope volume in dimension five is not computed.
title: A six-vertex inball rigidity threshold and fractional-matching incenters for complete-graph spanning-tree polytopes
